summary: Sheikh Ali Mashhour introduces a tafseer series on Surat Al-Anbiya, explaining why this chapter was selected to discuss the profound spiritual kinship among all prophets and messengers. He emphasizes that all prophets shared the same core religion (Islam), values, and calling, despite variations in their specific laws and prohibitions. The lecture explores how throughout history, the enemies of the prophets have used the same fundamental arguments for rejection, which have not changed despite differences in presentation or culture. The sheikh also provides detailed historical context on how the Quran was compiled and preserved, from the time of Prophet Muhammad through the collections of Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman, establishing the authenticity and reliability of the current Mushaf.
